title: Act I — Arrival
description: The learner joins Explorer Academy and reaches the abandoned research outpost. Initial missions focus on orientation, observation and learning how explorers work. The first anomalies are discovered.

title: Act II — Investigation
description: Recovered evidence reveals that the previous expedition was pursuing several interconnected investigations. Each mission uncovers another fragment through experiments, field work and problem-solving.

title: Act III — Reconstruction
description: The learner assembles the complete sequence of events. Missing records are recovered. Scientific conclusions are verified through evidence gathered across earlier missions.

title: Act IV — Graduation
description: The recovered archive is successfully restored. Explorer Academy recognises the learner as a fully qualified Explorer.
